artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan closing the unenforced per-phase Files-to-modify field with a measured two-tier validator check, a task-410 plan repair as the regression fixture, and an enforcement-level note in plan-format.md.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/tests/test-validate-artifact.sh (and siblings built on the same harness) resolve the script under test as $REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/<script> BEFORE the source-store sibling $SCRIPT_DIR/../<script>, with REPO_ROOT from `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`. Run such a suite from inside the agent-system source store and REPO_ROOT becomes the nvim config repo, whose own .claude/ deploy tree exists -- so the suite silently exercises THAT deployed copy, not the edit under test, and passes while proving nothing. Verify a source-store script edit by invoking the edited source-store file directly on fixtures; run the suite only from the target repo's deployed tree after a redeploy.
